{"metadata":{"description":"Unofficial DeepSeek Harness integration for lc2panda/wps-skills.","id":"gh:1333833220","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"wps-dsh-plugin","slug":"CatNebulaaaa/wps-dsh-plugin","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Unofficial DeepSeek Harness integration for lc2panda/wps-skills."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-wps-office"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Unofficial DeepSeek Harness integration for lc2panda/wps-skills."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"这是一个独立的 DSH 适配层。它不复制 WPS MCP、WPS 加载项或上游 Skills，而是通过 DSH 自带的 MCP Client 启动现有 `wps-office-mcp`，并补充一份适配"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"制 WPS MCP、WPS 加载项或上游 Skills，而是通过 DSH 自带的 MCP Client 启动现有 `wps-office-mcp`，并补充一份适配 DSH 工具命名的轻量 Skill。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> 当前按 DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.5` 开发和验证。DSH 仍处于 Developer Preview，后续版本可能产生破坏性变化。"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## 提供什么"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- 把 `wps-office-mcp` 的 stdio 服务挂载进 DSH。

- 注"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"册 `wps-office-dsh` Skill，提供 DSH 专用路由、安全和错误处理规则。

- Node.js 22.19+（22.x）或"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" Node.js 24+，以满足当前 DSH 的运行要求。
